name: Rosaria's Pizza
notes: 4 photos of hand-painted counter menu boards. Photo 1 is a wide shot (toppings list only, skipped as modifiers). Photo 2 is a medium shot of the sub/pizza/pick-up boards. Photo 3 is the widest, clearest shot of specialty pizzas, pastas, salads and the family specials, and is where most dishes came from. Photo 4 is a close, fully sharp shot of the appetizers/desserts/sides/drinks board, used for those exact prices. Size-tiered items (pizzas, subs) are listed at their smallest/base price since only one number can be recorded; several sizes/prices too small or angled to read reliably (Gourmet Veggie, Sriracha Combo, BBQ Chicken, Chicken Ranch/Cali Buffalo Chicken pizzas, Specialty Calzone) were dropped rather than guessed.
